<!-- Use this file to provide workspace-specific custom instructions to Copilot. For more details, visit https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/copilot-customization#_use-a-githubcopilotinstructionsmd-file -->

- [x] Verify that the copilot-instructions.md file in the .github directory is created.

- [x] Clarify Project Requirements
  - Node.js + TypeScript full-stack project
  - Modern tooling: ESLint, Prettier, Jest
  - Express/API server ready setup

- [x] Scaffold the Project
  - Created .github and src directories
  - Configured package.json with dev dependencies
  - TypeScript configuration ready
  - ESLint and Prettier configured

- [ ] Install Node.js
  - **REQUIRED**: Install Node.js v18+ from https://nodejs.org
  - Once installed, run `npm install` to install project dependencies

- [ ] Customize the Project
  - Additional customizations based on specific requirements

- [ ] Install Required Extensions
  - Prettier formatter (optional but recommended)
  - ESLint extension (optional)

- [ ] Compile the Project
  - Run `npm run build` to verify TypeScript compilation

- [ ] Create and Run Task
  - Setup dev server task with `npm run dev`

- [ ] Launch the Project
  - Ready for development once Node.js is installed

- [x] Ensure Documentation is Complete
  - README.md verified and complete
  - All configuration files created
